question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external-channel mirroring config, fold this into the broader origin-delivery or channel-pinning model, or keep Control UI delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the requested behavior crosses privacy and channel-delivery boundaries while adding config surface, so automation should not choose the product/security policy.

options.title: Decide under shared origin-delivery policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, and external-recipient rules with the broader routing work.

options.title: Ship narrow default-off mirror flag
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept separate WebChat mirroring semantics and require schema/docs/tests plus live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep explicit delivery only
options.body: Decline automatic mirroring if maintainers decide Control UI should never reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-turn delivery route.

recommendation.title: Decide under shared origin-delivery policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, and external-recipient rules with the broader routing work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current issue assignee and the remaining decision is product/security routing policy.
